gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-yuji-boku: Expressive and spaced like beads, Bruno Ace SC leads. Up top the open, unthinned lettering is built to announce; Yuji Boku is built to be read, with dignified strokes that hold one thickness like a drawn cable.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-nunito-sans: Distinctive from the first glance, Bruno Ace SC strings its letters like beads on a long thread. Nunito Sans supplies the best part, a soft, open-mouthed body that lets the heading's fixed-pressure strokes stand alone.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-author: Horseshoe-wide c, marker-tip lines, heavy diagonals: Cherry Swash is all swagger. Author brings slight swell on the bowls and a refined, dignified manner, leaving Cherry Swash to earn its keep big and brief.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-dm-sans: Cherry Swash opens its c like a horseshoe and keeps every line at a steady weight, diagonals included. DM Sans brings the pair its friendliest quality: approachable sans-serif letters with wide-set terminals on the s.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-aleo: A horseshoe c and sturdy diagonals: Cherry Swash arrives loudly. Cherry Swash is best at commanding, uniform-weight display; Aleo is best at dignified text, its counters letting the eye slip in and out.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-almendra-sc: Almendra SC lends an authoritative, dignified voice, its mouths staying open on c, e, and a. Almendra SC wants a generous size, so those mouths can work, while Cherry Swash holds a constant-weight line.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-antic-slab: Horseshoe curves, sturdy diagonals: Cherry Swash opens wide, while Antic Slab sits beneath with round bowls of uniform wall. Page after page feels dignified and editorial, with wide, barely curled s curves.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-arvo: Arvo reads traditional and dignified, its curves refusing to close all the way. And Cherry Swash, wire-like in line and horseshoe-wide in its c, adds the commanding voice above.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-belgrano: A c opened wide like a horseshoe marks Cherry Swash, drawn with a bent-paperclip look and no swelling. And Belgrano makes long reading go smoothly, its open-mouthed curves staying clear in a classic, traditional voice.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-biorhyme: BioRhyme brings a bookish, refined voice, with brush-like curve endings and widely spaced capitals, under Cherry Swash's constant-width pen line. Longer text moves at an unhurried, refined pace throughout.
